A `requires`/`produces` id on a node must resolve in a data model (models:check TM-005), so the ids are kept OFF the nodes and recorded here per node until /qa-test-data-model build srch declares them; then move each list onto its node. nodes.notes: Distinct from srch.barcode.expand.second-term-literal, which is the xAPI filter-syntax case of two barcode: term filters inside one query value; this is the URL-query-array case the storefront composable guards against. Not live-verified this wave.

nodes.name: The single-hit redirect only fires from the response matching its own request, never a superseded one

evidence.note: review-thread fix r6: shouldOpenSingleBarcodeHit binds the redirect decision to the request that produced it, guarding a fast second scan/edit from redirecting on a stale response

nodes.notes: Corresponds to the test model's RACE archetype row (shouldOpenSingleBarcodeHit request-binding), WAIVED there as not deterministically drivable through MCP; covered by the PR's own unit tests, not live this wave.

nodes.name: A barcode lookup fires the same view-search-results analytics event as a keyword search

evidence.note: review-thread fix r7: viewSearchResults analytics now fires for barcode lookups too, not only ?q= keyword searches
